title: Cannabis, CBD and other controlled substances: sale and promotion
summary: Cannabis and often CBD are prohibited in much of Asia and the Gulf and restricted elsewhere. Lawful or licensed markets include Canada, Uruguay, Germany (limited), Netherlands pilot, Malta and some US states, with local licences needed. CBD restrictions vary widely.

countries.name: Saudi Arabia
countries.note: Cannabis and CBD products criminalised, severe penalties. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: Cannabis and THC prohibited; CBD heavily restricted. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: Misuse of Drugs Act: cannabis and cannabinoids prohibited, including CBD. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Japan
countries.note: THC prohibited; CBD allowed only if THC-free from seeds/stems. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Indonesia
countries.note: Cannabis Schedule I; death penalty possible. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Malaysia
countries.note: Dangerous Drugs Act; medicinal cannabis limited. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: China
countries.note: Cannabis banned; industrial hemp only in some provinces. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: Cannabis and CBD with THC prohibited. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Thailand
countries.note: Since June 2025, cannabis flower requires doctor prescription; recreational sale banned; <0.2% THC products allowed. Sources are mostly secondary.

countries.name: Turkey
countries.note: Cannabis banned; licensed hemp for industry only. From general knowledge, unverified.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Cannabis prohibited. From general knowledge, unverified.
